glossary.ja: ウィンゲルバインダー
glossary.role: Weapon 4 of the A.Taul (Gablae's Heavy Metal): two arm-mounted binders launched by remote control.
Poseidal's life-energy system: heals armor (Aug's Weapon 4, akurasu); Poseidal also uses it to brainwash the commander of his Imperial Guard (menu3019#38).
L-Gaim Mk-II / Novel D.Sserd main cannon (バスターランチャー(フルパワー) = full power).
Buster Ark's remote weapon pods that surround the target (Weapon 2).

glossary.series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Gundam Deathscythe Hell's jamming device (Weapon 5): evades enemy lock-on for a time, drains vernier.
Standard Heavy Metal launcher weapon (also ダブルパワーランチャー = Double Power Launcher).
Defensive field of aura machines and aura ships; Weapon 4 of the Dunbine-family units (reduces damage for a time).
The Layzner's (and Zakaal's) overdrive system: wraps the unit in a blue magnetic field for a high-speed charge that is impervious to lasers ('Blue Comet').
Unit ability; game also writes アビリティー.
Sazabi's remote psycommu weapon (Weapon 6); ν Gundam's version is フィン・ファンネル (Fin Funnel).
Nanajin's ability (auto-activates at low armor; also usable as a barrier) and the series title (menu3022#12).
The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
Boost thrust resource (バーニア消費).
